title: festuca rubra subsp. multiflora
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. multiflora, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of flowering grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra subsp. multiflora include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
